personality: 1 iOS-Native Clean (Adapted for Premium Senegalese Services)
personality_one_liner: A highly trustworthy, minimalist, and premium Senegalese service marketplace that feels as reliable and fluid as Uber or Airbnb.

spacing.rule: Use generous padding and margins to create the requested 'beaucoup d'espace blanc'. Let content breathe. Use 24px (xl) or 32px (2xl) for screen edges and major sections.

do's: Use glass effect on sticky headers over scrolling content.
Use glass on the bottom tab bar.
Use glass for the fixed bottom CTA container on the Pro Details and Booking screens.
Use glass for floating action buttons or map filters.
dont's: Never apply glass to standard cards, form inputs, or list items.

screens.name: Splash
screens.purpose: Brand entry with animated Jokoo logo.
screens.layout: Solid surface Inverse (#0B1F3A) or surface (#FFFFFF) with a perfectly centered logo. Minimal and premium.

screens.name: Onboarding
screens.purpose: Introduce the value prop to users (3 steps).
screens.layout: Full-bleed high-quality imagery of Senegalese professionals. A vertical gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse) at the bottom 40%. Large Poppins white text on top of the scrim, with a pill-shaped brandPrimary CTA at the bottom thumb zone.

screens.name: Auth
screens.purpose: Login and Registration for both Clients and Providers.

states.error: Inline red error text below failing inputs.

screens.layout: Clean layout with a segmented control or toggle for Client vs Prestataire. Form inputs use surfaceTertiary with pill radius. Sticky submit button above keyboard.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Discovery and search for services and nearby professionals.

states.loading: Skeleton loaders for cards and categories.
states.empty: No pros nearby: Illustration + 'Try a different area' CTA.
states.error: Failed to load: Toast message + Retry button.

screens.layout: Top Header: User address/location and greeting. Sticky search bar (glass or solid surface). Horizontal scrolling category chips (rounded). Hero Promo Banner (rounded corners, subtle brand gradient). Horizontal scroll for 'Pros near you' (cards with photo, name, rating, job). Vertical list for 'Top Rated'. Ample bottom padding for the glass tab bar.

screens.name: Pro Detail
screens.purpose: Showcase a professional's profile, reviews, and portfolio.

states.loading: Skeleton loader matching the profile layout.

screens.layout: Cover Photo/Gallery on top with a glass back-button overlay. Profile Photo floats overlapping the cover and surface. Content sections (Description, Pricing, Reviews, Badges). Fixed bottom CTA container (glass) with 'Réserver' (brandPrimary) and 'Discuter/Appeler' (secondary) buttons.

screens.name: Booking
screens.purpose: Step-by-step flow to select date, time, address, and view estimates.
screens.layout: Single column layout. Clear typography. Large touch targets for Date/Time selection (pills or large calendar cells). Sticky CTA at the bottom in a KeyboardAvoidingView.

screens.name: Payment
screens.purpose: Select payment method (Wave, Orange Money, Card, Cash).
screens.layout: Clean radio-button style list of payment methods using surfaceSecondary cards. Clear summary of total cost. Large sticky primary button at the bottom.

screens.name: Chat
screens.purpose: Real-time messaging between client and provider.

states.empty: No messages yet illustration + 'Say hi!' text.
states.error: Red exclamation mark next to failed messages.

screens.layout: Glass sticky header with Pro's name and photo. Chat bubbles: brandPrimary for sender, surfaceSecondary for receiver. Rounded corners (pill-like). Input field sticky at bottom above keyboard.

screens.name: Provider Dashboard
screens.purpose: Management hub for professionals (earnings, calendar, requests).
screens.layout: High-level stats cards at the top (Earnings, Bookings). Calendar widget. Vertical list of recent or upcoming requests. Clean, data-focused, lots of white space between metrics.

instructions_to_main_agent: STRICT COLOR PALETTE: Only use the defined Midnight Blue (#0B1F3A), Turquoise (#00C2A8), and White (#FFFFFF) tokens. Do not introduce random purples or standard blues.
TYPOGRAPHY: Exclusively use 'Poppins' for all text elements. Maintain the weight cap at 500. Use sizing for hierarchy, not ultra-bold weights.
LAYOUT & SPACING: The client requested 'beaucoup d'espace blanc'. Apply `xl` (24px) or `2xl` (32px) margins/padding heavily on root views and between major sections.
COMPONENTS: Ensure all buttons, chips, and cards use rounded corners (`md` to `pill`) as specified by 'coins arrondis'. Shadows must remain light (tier 1).
GLASSMORPHISM: Apply glass effects selectively to floating/sticky elements (headers, tab bars, bottom CTAs) to enhance the 'Premium' feel without cluttering.
LOCALIZATION: Ensure all placeholders and labels reflect the Senegalese/Francophone context (e.g., 'Wave', 'Orange Money', 'Dakar', 'Prestataire').
LEARNINGS FROM RESEARCH: Mobbin-style marketplace UI thrives on high-trust signals. Always display verified badges, clear star ratings, and response times prominently on Pro cards.
